Title: AKUH enhances diagnostic services - Nuclear Medicine inaugurated
NewsSummary: The range of specialised clinical services at Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) continues to expand, the latest addition being the Nuclear Medicine programme.
NewsContent:
The range of specialised clinical services at Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) continues to expand, the latest addition being the Nuclear Medicine programme. 

The new facility of Nuclear Medicine in the Department of Radiology at Aga Khan University Hospital was made possible with the generous support of donors.

Equipped with state-of-the-art Dual Head Variable Angle Gamma Camera, the only one of its kind in Pakistan, the Nuclear Medicine Suite at the Department of Radiology will offer services such as bone, renal, hepatobiliary, lung, cardiac and gallium scintigraphy. This is an addition to the existing facilities like X-ray, mammography ultrasound, CT, MRI and interventional radiology being offered by AKUH. 

Addressing the donors who had contributed to the establishment of this facility, Dr. Shamsh Kassim-Lakha, President, AKU, said, "Our Institution is blessed with donors and volunteers who have supported it so generously. By supporting AKUH's Patient Welfare Programme, you have enabled us to provide this service at a reasonable price to the people who may not be able to afford its full charges." 

Speaking on behalf of the donors, Mr. Munir Kamal, CEO and President of the Union Bank, said, "It is indeed a joy to witness the opening of a new facility and to be associated with this University. We should all be proud that such a facility exists in Karachi." 

Dr. M. Younus Sheikh, Chair of Department of Radiology at AKUH, informed that with the availability of Nuclear Medicine, patients will now have all imaging modalities like interventional radiology and CT scan, under one roof. Nuclear Medicine will not only enhance diagnostic services to patients, but also boost education. The medical students of the University will now have on-campus facility for developing hands-on expertise in nuclear medicine and postgraduate education.
